meta.title: Amir Abroun — Full-Stack Developer
meta.description: Amir Abroun — full-stack developer with 6+ years of experience. Laravel APIs, Vue & Nuxt frontends, Docker & CI/CD. Currently at Sanjeman.

hero.sub: Laravel APIs on the backend, Vue & Nuxt on the frontend, and the Docker, Nginx & CI plumbing in between — I build web products end-to-end.

about.heading: A backend-heavy full-stack developer who ships
about.p1: I'm a full-stack developer with 6+ years of experience, based in Iran and comfortable anywhere in the stack — from database schemas and Laravel APIs to Nuxt frontends and the CI/CD pipeline that ships them.
about.p2: These days I'm at Sanjeman, building the recruitment platform at sanjeman.com: a Laravel backend powering Nuxt 3 and Vue frontends, SSO, browser extensions and integrations with payments, SMS providers and job boards — plus the DevOps (Docker, Nginx, GitLab CI, GlitchTip error tracking) that keeps it all running in production.
about.p3: When I'm not shipping features, I'm probably tuning Docker images, hunting errors in GlitchTip, or picking up Go.

education.label: Education
education.value: B.Sc. Computer Engineering, Hakim Sabzevari University

experience.heading: Where I've been shipping
bullets: Build and evolve the core Laravel API platform behind sanjeman.com — a recruitment product serving the Iranian market.
Ship and maintain Nuxt 3 and Vue frontends: the main product, the admin panel and SSO flows.
Own DevOps end-to-end — Docker, Nginx, GitLab CI/CD pipelines and production MySQL & Redis.
Integrate external services: payment gateways, SMS providers and job-board partners.
Keep production healthy — GlitchTip/Sentry error triage, performance tuning and code review across the team.
